archaeologist--noun.def: A scientist who studies the past by digging up remains.

contradict--verb.def: To say the opposite of what someone else said.
contradict--verb.ex: The two reports contradict each other.

silverware--noun.def: Knives, forks and dishes made of silver.

inspirational--adj.def: Making people want to do something good.

concession--noun.def: Something you allow in order to end a disagreement.

dormitory--noun.def: A large room or building where students sleep.

patriotism--noun.def: Strong love and support for your country.

sprint--noun.def: A short race run at full speed.
sprint--noun.ex: He won the hundred metre sprint.

inseparable--adj.def: Always together and impossible to separate.

passionately--adv.ex: He spoke passionately about the river.

tiresome--adj.def: Annoying because it continues too long.

complexity--noun.def: The state of having many connected parts.

slang--noun.def: Very informal words used by a particular group.

endeavor--noun.def: A serious attempt to do something.
endeavor--noun.ex: The rescue was a brave endeavor.

unrest--noun.def: Angry public dissatisfaction that may lead to protest.

abruptly--adv.def: Suddenly and in an unexpected way.

outlook--noun.def: The likely future, or a way of looking at life.

eyebrow--noun.def: The line of hair above your eye.

unwilling--adj.ex: They were unwilling to pay more.

enduring--adj.def: Continuing for a very long time.

petrified--adj.def: So frightened that you cannot move.

attentive--adj.def: Listening carefully, or looking after someone well.

equity--noun.def: Fair treatment, or the value you own in a property.

guerrilla--noun.def: A member of a small unofficial fighting group.

tulip--noun.def: A brightly coloured spring flower grown from a bulb.
tulip--noun.ex: The tulip is a symbol of Istanbul.

analogy--noun.def: A comparison used to explain something.
analogy--noun.ex: He drew an analogy with a river.

dreamy--adj.def: Not paying attention, or gentle and pleasant.

contradiction--noun.def: A statement that disagrees with another.

nominee--noun.def: A person suggested for a job or a prize.

wartime--noun.def: The period during which a war is fought.
wartime--noun.ex: Her mother grew up in wartime.

concede--verb.def: To admit that something is true, or to accept defeat.
concede--verb.ex: He conceded that he was wrong.

trait--noun.def: A particular quality of a person's character.

chemotherapy--noun.def: The treatment of cancer with strong drugs.

hazardous--adj.def: Risky and likely to cause harm.
hazardous--adj.ex: The work is hazardous without gloves.

variation--noun.def: A difference in amount or in form.
variation--noun.ex: There is wide variation in prices.

undertake--verb.def: To agree to do a piece of work.

benevolent--adj.def: Kind and wanting to help people.
benevolent--adj.ex: A benevolent donor paid for it.

distributor--noun.def: A company that supplies goods to shops.

follower--noun.def: A person who supports a leader or an idea.

neighboring--adj.def: Next to or very near something.
neighboring--adj.ex: They fled to a neighboring village.

tremendously--adv.def: Extremely, to a very great degree.

recollection--noun.def: Something you remember, or the act of remembering.
recollection--noun.ex: I have no recollection of that day.
recollection--noun.exTr: O güne dair hiçbir anım yok.

exclude--verb.def: To keep someone or something out.

forthcoming--adj.ex: Her forthcoming book is a novel.

startle--verb.def: To surprise someone suddenly and slightly frighten them.

erect--adj.ex: The soldiers stood erect at the gate.

kerosene--noun.def: A fuel oil used in lamps and heaters.

millimeter--noun.def: A unit of length equal to a thousandth of a metre.

detachment--noun.def: A lack of emotional involvement, or a small military unit.

gulp--noun.def: A large swallow of drink or air.
gulp--noun.ex: He drank it in one gulp.

discredit--verb.def: To make people stop trusting someone.

ammonia--noun.def: A strong-smelling gas used in cleaning products.

commute--verb.def: To travel regularly between home and work.

revival--noun.def: The return of something to life or popularity.
revival--noun.ex: The town saw an economic revival.

seasonal--adj.def: Happening only at one time of the year.

yearn--verb.def: To want something very much for a long time.

unofficial--adj.def: Not announced or approved by an authority.

sulfur--noun.def: A yellow chemical element with a strong smell.

nobleman--noun.def: A man of high social rank in the past.

indispensable--adj.def: So useful that you cannot manage without it.
indispensable--adj.ex: She is indispensable to the team.

acquisition--noun.def: The act of getting something, or a company bought.

coastline--noun.def: The outline of a coast seen from above.

imagery--noun.def: The pictures words create in your mind.

ornament--noun.def: An object kept because it is attractive.
ornament--noun.ex: A glass ornament sat on the shelf.
ornament--noun.exTr: Rafta cam bir süs eşyası duruyordu.

glare--noun.def: Strong unpleasant light, or an angry stare.
glare--noun.ex: The glare off the snow hurt.

rejoin--verb.def: To join a group again after leaving it.
rejoin--verb.ex: He rejoined the club last year.

arouse--verb.def: To cause a feeling or a reaction in someone.

redundant--adj.def: No longer needed, especially in a job.
redundant--adj.ex: Two hundred workers were made redundant.

landslide--noun.def: A mass of earth sliding down a slope, or a huge election win.

hover--verb.def: To stay in one place in the air.
hover--verb.ex: A hawk hovered above the field.
hover--verb.exTr: Bir atmaca tarlanın üstünde asılı durdu.

thinker--noun.def: A person known for serious and original ideas.

deficit--noun.def: The amount by which money spent is more than money earned.
